title: Nice aquarium to visit
text: The aquarium was really nice and had alot of different sea animals to see. The underwater tunnel was my favorite part. It wasnt too big but still a fun place to spend some time while visiting Barcelona.
author: Coastal23347428508

title: Nice experience in Barcelona
text:
entry was quick and everything worked fine with the ticket
the aquarium is really nice and the shark tunnel was probably my favorite part
a bit busy inside but still worth visiting
